line.aria-label: date: Feb 04, 2022; event_kind: proposed_for_inclusion; Normalized state: PFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2022-02-04; Historical label: "probably the other biggest one is withdrawal the beacon chain which does not have an eip yet" (ACD 131 Shanghai prioritization discussion); Normalization rationale: On ACD 131 (2022-02-04) beacon-chain withdrawals were raised as a top Shanghai priority before any EIP existed ("once we have a beacon chain withdrawal eip we can discuss that in more detail"). This is recorded as the proposal event for the feature that became EIP-4895 (frontmatter created 2022-03-10); the normalization notes that no EIP number existed at the time, so the event attaches to the fork-EIP relationship retrospectively by feature identity, not by number.; Source: All Core Devs Meeting 131 notes/transcript (2022-02-04); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/ecf2eecc74adc479cea38b3d3b9a670c320421b1/AllCoreDevs-EL-Meetings/Meeting%20131.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/ecf2eecc74adc479cea38b3d3b9a670c320421b1/AllCoreDevs-EL-Meetings/Meeting%20131.md

date: Mar 18, 2022; event_kind: considered_for_inclusion; Normalized state: CFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2022-03-18; Historical label: Decision 134.3 "EIP-4895 move to CFI"; added to "EIPs Considered for Inclusion" ("Agreed in ACD134"); Normalization rationale: ACD 134 (2022-03-18) compared the two withdrawal designs (transaction-type EIP-4863 vs operations-based EIP-4895), settled on EIP-4895, and its decisions table records "EIP-4895 move to CFI" (item 134.3). The execution-specs commit authored the same day ("Add EIP 4895", body "Agreed in ACD134", merged via PR #477 on 2022-03-23) added it to "EIPs Considered for Inclusion". path.aria-label: date: Mar 31, 2022; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2022-03-31T15:08:34+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Specifies the serialisation position of the new fields: block body becomes RLP([transactions, ommers, withdrawals]) and block RLP becomes RLP([header, transactions, ommers, withdrawals]); adds a dedicated 'New field in the execution block header: withdrawals root' section with the full 16-element header RLP list ending in `withdrawals_root`; adds two NOTEs referring to EIP-3675 for the fixed ommers value and other fixed header values; drops the TODO about logs and receipts; expands the rationale on operations vs transactions and on the block-footprint bound (~1% of average block size).; Classification rationale: Defines the concrete block-body and block-header encodings that clients must implement, and removes an unresolved specification TODO.; Confidence: high; Commit: b4b1218d0807ac75c86f4d0eae82e89b1fa91f39; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b4b1218d0807ac75c86f4d0eae82e89b1fa91f39; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b4b1218d0807ac75c86f4d0eae82e89b1fa91f39

The historical CFI term maps directly to considered_for_inclusion; occurred_at uses the decision/commit-author date.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/ecf2eecc74adc479cea38b3d3b9a670c320421b1/AllCoreDevs-EL-Meetings/Meeting%20134.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/ecf2eecc74adc479cea38b3d3b9a670c320421b1/AllCoreDevs-EL-Meetings/Meeting%20134.md
